Generate pseudotime trajectory (supervised).

# Load libraries

Load the necessary libraries.
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(dplyr)
library(destiny)
library(STEAM)
library(future)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(reshape2)
library(scales)
```


# Load data

Load Seurat object.
```{r}
lineage_cells <- readRDS("Seurat_objects/Postnatal_human_seurat_v5_GNxEarly_filtered.rds")
lineage_cells

head(lineage_cells[[]])
```

Update metadata
```{r}
lineage_cells$cell_anno[lineage_cells$cell_anno == "early_GN"] <- "GN"
```


Check number of cells per cell type of the cluster annotation you want to create Trajectory MetaCells from.
```{r}
table(lineage_cells$cell_anno)
```



Check numbar of genes and counts:
```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.height=7}
cell_colors <- c(
  "NSC" = "#FC8D62",
  "INP" = "#E78AC3",
  "NB"  = "#8DA0CB",
  "YGN" = "#A6D854",
  "GN"  = "#66C2A5"
)

# Reorder the identities to match the order in cell_colors
lineage_cells$cell_anno <- factor(lineage_cells$cell_anno, levels = names(cell_colors))


VlnPlot(lineage_cells, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA"), ncol = 1, group.by = "cell_anno",cols = cell_colors)
```


# Pseudotime analysis

Preprocess data.
```{r}
# 1. Normalize data
lineage_cells <- NormalizeData(lineage_cells)

# 2. Find variable features
lineage_cells <- FindVariableFeatures(lineage_cells)

# 3. Scale data
lineage_cells <- ScaleData(lineage_cells)

# 4. Run PCA
lineage_cells <- RunPCA(lineage_cells)

# 5. Elbow plot to help choose number of PCs
ElbowPlot(lineage_cells, ndims = 50)  # plots variance explained by top 50 PCs

```


Calculate a tSNE plot.
```{r}
# Run t-SNE using the first 20 PCs
set.seed(123)
lineage_cells <- RunTSNE(lineage_cells, dims = 1:20, reduction = "pca")

# Plot t-SNE colored by cell_anno
DimPlot(lineage_cells, reduction = "tsne", group.by = "cell_anno", label = TRUE,cols = cell_colors)
```

```{r, eval=T}
# Close PDF device
dev.off()
```

Calculate diffusion map and pseudotime.
```{r}

pcs <- Embeddings(lineage_cells, "harmony")[, 1:50]  # cells × harmonized PCs

# Run diffusion map
dm <- DiffusionMap(pcs)  # transpose: cells × harmonized PCs

# Compute pseudotime (DPT)
dpt <- DPT(dm)

# Assign to Seurat metadata
dpt_named <- setNames(dpt$DPT1, colnames(dm@transitions))
lineage_cells$DPT <- NA
lineage_cells$DPT[Cells(lineage_cells)] <- dpt_named[Cells(lineage_cells)]

```


Check diffusion pseudotime (DPT) distribution, using destiny, sometime the time order is reversed.
```{r}
aggregate(DPT ~ cell_anno, data = lineage_cells[[]], summary)
```


```{r}
rank_cells <- function(dpt_values, reverse = FALSE) {
  if (!is.logical(reverse) || length(reverse) != 1) {
    stop("`reverse` must be a single TRUE/FALSE value.")
  }

  if (reverse) {
    return(rank(-dpt_values, ties.method = "first"))
  } else {
    return(rank(dpt_values, ties.method = "first"))
  }
}

```


```{r}
lineage_cells$cell_rank <- rank_cells(lineage_cells$DPT, reverse=F)

head(lineage_cells[[]])
```


Assign metadata that manually order cells by lineage.
```{r}
order_cells_by_lineage <- function(seurat_obj,
                                           cell_rank_col = "cell_rank",
                                           cell_type_col = "cell_anno",
                                           lineage_order) {
  meta <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  
  # Checks
  if (!(cell_rank_col %in% colnames(meta))) stop("cell_rank_col not found in metadata")
  if (!(cell_type_col %in% colnames(meta))) stop("cell_type_col not found in metadata")
  if (!is.character(lineage_order)) stop("lineage_order must be a character vector")
  
  # Ensure numeric
  cell_ranks <- as.numeric(meta[[cell_rank_col]])
  
  # Initialize vector to store new ranks
  new_ranks <- numeric(length(cell_ranks))
  
  counter <- 1  # running counter for new ranks
  
  for (ct in lineage_order) {
    idx <- which(meta[[cell_type_col]] == ct)
    # Sort within cell type
    sorted_idx <- idx[order(cell_ranks[idx])]
    n <- length(sorted_idx)
    new_ranks[sorted_idx] <- counter:(counter + n - 1)
    counter <- counter + n
  }
  
  return(new_ranks)
}

```


```{r}
# Assign directly to Seurat object
lineage_cells$cell_rank_ordered <- order_cells_by_lineage(
  lineage_cells,
  cell_rank_col = "cell_rank",
  cell_type_col = "cell_anno",
  lineage_order = c("NSC","INP","NB","YGN","GN")
)

# Check
head(lineage_cells[[]])
tail(lineage_cells[[]])
```



Check the cell rank order for each cell type
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

df <- data.frame(
  DC1 = eigenvectors(dm)[,1],
  DC2 = eigenvectors(dm)[,2],
  pseudotime_rank = lineage_cells$cell_rank_ordered,
  cell_anno = lineage_cells$cell_anno
)


df <- df %>%
  group_by(cell_anno) %>%
  mutate(
    pseudotime_within_cluster =
      (pseudotime_rank - min(pseudotime_rank)) /
      (max(pseudotime_rank) - min(pseudotime_rank))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = DC1, y = DC2, color = pseudotime_within_cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  scale_color_gradient(
    low = "blue",
    high = "red",
    name = "Within-cluster\npseudotime"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ cell_anno) +
  theme_classic() +
  ggtitle("Diffusion map: within-cluster pseudotime progression")

p
```

```{r, eval=T}
# Open PDF device
pdf("STEAM_plots/DC_plot_pseudotime_ranked_within_clusters_harmony.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)  # width & height in inches

p

# Close PDF device
dev.off()
```

Lets identify the outliers and add the information to the metadata.
```{r}
# Define a cutoff for pseudotime across all cells
cutoff <- 10  # DPT value you consider "too high", i.e., outlier

# Flag cells above the cutoff
high_dpt_cells <- WhichCells(lineage_cells, expression = DPT > cutoff)

# Add a new metadata column
lineage_cells$DPT_outlier <- ifelse(Cells(lineage_cells) %in% high_dpt_cells, "outlier", "normal")
table(lineage_cells$DPT_outlier)
head(lineage_cells[[]])
```


We then re-plot the tSNE and color the outlier in grey.
```{r}
# Prepare dataframe for ggplot
df <- data.frame(
  tSNE1 = Embeddings(lineage_cells, "tsne")[,1],
  tSNE2 = Embeddings(lineage_cells, "tsne")[,2],
  pseudotime_ordered = lineage_cells$cell_rank_ordered,
  is_outlier = lineage_cells$DPT_outlier == "outlier"
)

# Plot, graying out outliers
ggplot(df, aes(x = tSNE1, y = tSNE2)) +
  geom_point(data = subset(df, is_outlier), color = "grey80", size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = subset(df, !is_outlier), aes(color = pseudotime_ordered), size = 1) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "B") +
  theme_classic() +
  ggtitle("tSNE colored by pseudotime (outliers grayed out)")
```
